posts.text:
🇺🇸🇮🇷🇧🇭 Iran hit an industrial site in Bahrain tonight... and the target may have been a US radar parked among civilians

Anthony Aguilar, a retired Green Beret lieutenant colonel, believes the burning site was one of the radar targets, since these systems are mobile and the US parks them in everyday places:

"You can roll them out of your garage. You can put them on top of the shopping center. You can put them in a neighborhood street. And we do that. We absolutely do do that because I've seen it done in all of my deployments."

If Iran keeps hunting these radars, how long before a strike aimed at one lands on somebody's street?

🇮🇷🇺🇸🇧🇭 Iranian missiles and drones were fired at US bases in Bahrain tonight... and the real escalation may still be coming

Retired Green Beret Lt. Col. Anthony Aguilar reacted live to the alerts, told viewers to mark November 21, 2026 on their calendars, and warned the worst is still ahead:

"We're going to see Iran flip the page and start taking the initiative and the offensive out of the defense that they've been in for the last eight and a half months, and it will be devastating."

Bahrain says one strike set a civilian industrial site on fire, and if this is only the opening page, Gulf air defenses need to be ready for far worse.
